_comment: Manual corrections/supplements merged on top of ProPublica fetches by step2f. Typical use: latest fiscal year not yet digitized by ProPublica (IRS processing lags ~1 year) — numbers are extracted from the Form 990 PDF by vision read with arithmetic cross-checks (Part VIII/IX totals, Part X balance sheet). Archive: data/raw/finances/pdfs/{CONF}_{TAXPERIOD}.pdf; transcripts: data/raw/finances/transcripts/{CONF}_{TAXPERIOD}.md; web copies of both under website/public/data/finances/. 'transcript' is a BASE_URL-relative path for the Finances view.

NEURIPS.note: FY2025 (tax period 202505, conference year 2024) manually extracted from the IRS Form 990 PDF on 2026-10-10, pending ProPublica digitization. Figures cross-checked across Part I, Part VIII/IX totals and Part X balance sheet; prior-year column matches ProPublica exactly.
